article_summaries.title: TCG Expansion, Shattered Past, Is Available
article_summaries.summary: Official freerealms.com news post announcing the Shattered Past expansion for the Free Realms Trading Card Game. It covers the story hook, over 100 new cards with new mechanics, four Marketplace starter decks, and virtual rewards in booster packs. The page gives a relative posting time ('6 days, 19 hours ago') against a 2009-09-22 capture, so the exact date is unknown.
